provenance.title: Hidden trigger, blocked bypass, verified run, undo
provenance.scenario: Hollow Creek Farm: marking a patch sold out fires a database trigger that deletes open orders.

mission-t25v2-a.story: Plan 0 loses one protected order (trigger patches_release_sold_out), plan 1 tries to drop the trigger, plan 2 is SAFE, a human approves it, it runs and the result equals the rehearsal.
mission-t25v2-a.agent: The three plans are the SQL of T25 v3 run T3, replayed through the MCP tools by a script. They were not written by a live agent during this recording.
mission-t25v2-a.approval: The approval of apr-bcf96b7530615545 was given by a human in the Console. Two earlier requests of this mission expired unanswered.
mission-t25v2-a.title: Hidden Trigger: Prevented Data Loss

mission-demo-b.story: A SAFE plan is authorized, runs, is undone, and the recovery verification passes.
mission-demo-b.agent: The plan is a fixed demo migration, not an agent run.
mission-demo-b.approval: The authorization was given by a script that piped the approver passphrase to the CLI; no human decision is recorded for it.
mission-demo-b.limit: The recovery verification of this run compared row counts, checksums, schema and files. It did not compare database grants: the capture was made before privileges were recorded (fixed since, PR 21).
mission-demo-b.title: Backfill Quantities: Run, Undo, Recovery Check

provenance.not_included: Docker, PostgreSQL, captures (pg dumps) and private keys are not part of this export.
